subject: Proposal: Credits & Trial Extension for NexUse after EU Region Slowdown
messages:
From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@nexuse.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Severe impact — EU region slowdown (May 17) — request for remediation and credit

Hi Marissa,

We had a major production impact last night tied to Redwood's EU cluster. Starting ~22:05 UTC on May 17 we experienced elevated 5xx rates and timeouts across our inference calls; the platform was intermittently unavailable for roughly three hours. The failures caused one of our nightly pipelines to fail and blocked customer-facing features for a subset of our users.

Attached is a quick CSV with our request/response error counts and timestamps (nexuse_incident_timeline.csv) and a few screenshots from our monitoring. We're looking for:
- A brief timeline and root-cause summary from Redwood ops
- Confirmation of logs for our queries during the window
- Compensation for the production impact (credits and/or trial extension) while we evaluate recovery options

This is urgent for our ops review — can you escalate? Thanks.

— Ari
Ari Patel
Head of Platform — NexUse Analytics
ari.patel@nexuse.ai

--- Attachment(s): nexuse_incident_timeline.csv, service-impact-screenshots.zip
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@nexuse.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Severe impact — EU region slowdown (May 17) — request for remediation and credit

Hi Ari —

I'm really sorry about the disruption and appreciate the timeline and screenshots. I've escalated immediately to SRE and CS; we'll pull the relevant logs and produce a short incident summary within 24 hours.

Preliminarily, we'd like to offer a gesture while we investigate: 15,000 token credit applied to your account and a 30-day extension to your trial window so NexUse has breathing room while we complete the RCA. I need signoff from finance/ops for the exact credit value — looping in Jonas and Grace to approve and finalize.

I'll attach a short acknowledgement that we received your timeline (incident_ack_20280518.txt) and will follow up with the formal amendment/DocuSign link once approved.

Again — sincerely sorry. We'll get you a timeline and proposed remediation by tomorrow EOD.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

--- Attachment(s): incident_ack_20280518.txt
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Severe impact — NexUse — proposed interim credit

Jonas / Grace — forwarding Ari's timeline. Quick context: NexUse hit ~3 hours of elevated errors in EU overnight (attached CSV). They're asking for credits and logs. Proposal for internal approval:

- 15,000 token credit + 30-day trial extension as initial gesture (Marissa suggested)
- If you think it's appropriate per policy, given >3h user impact we should consider 20,000 tokens or an invoice credit equivalent
- Need legal/finance signoff on DocuSign amendment language; would like to send customer a final offer today

Questions: 1) Approve 15k vs 20k? 2) Any reason to escalate to leadership on policy precedent?

Thanks — I can draft the amendment once you confirm.

Marissa
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Severe impact — NexUse — proposed interim credit

Marissa — thanks for flagging.

Approve moving forward with a stronger gesture: 20,000 token credit + 30-day extension. Rationale: the impact window >3 hours for production traffic and this is a strategic account (deal NX-473, pipeline expansion in Q3). Please proceed but mark the credit as one-time goodwill (no entitlement expansion to SLA). I'll notify Finance to expect documentation for internal cost allocation.

Also loop Legal on the amendment wording (simple credit + extension). No leadership escalation needed unless Legal flags something unusual.

Jonas
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Severe impact — NexUse — proposed interim credit

Agree with Jonas — 20k tokens + 30 days. A couple of asks for the outbound:
- Make it explicit the credit is a one-time remedy for the May 17 incident and does not change the contract SLA.
- Offer a small operational gesture (trial extension + priority triage for 30 days) to reduce churn risk.
- Copy finance@redwood.com on the final note so they can reconcile.

I can take a quick pass on the customer-facing language if you want. Otherwise good to send.

Grace O'Connor
VP Revenue | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@nexuse.ai>, Sofia Kim <s.kim@nexuse.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, finance@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-20T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Severe impact — EU region slowdown (May 17) — remediation and credit offer

Hi Ari / Sofia —

Thank you again for the timeline and patience while we investigated. Below is our remediation offer for the May 17 EU incident (we've attached a short incident summary and the CSV you provided for reference).

Offer:
- 20,000 token credit applied to your account (one-time goodwill credit; no change to SLA)
- 30-day trial extension from the current expiration date
- Priority triage for your account for the next 30 days (engineering on-call for escalations)

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached amendment (nexuse_credit_amendment.docx). If you approve, sign the DocuSign link here: https://docusign.com/ndoc/AA12-87-nx-473 and we'll post the credit within 48 hours of signature.
2) If you'd prefer we can issue a token grant directly and follow up with a short amendment; let me know which you prefer.

We truly regret the disruption — teams have already implemented rate-safety fixes and improved internal alerts for the EU cluster. I'm attaching the incident summary and our initial RCA draft for your review.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

--- Attachment(s): nexuse_incident_timeline.csv, nexuse_credit_amendment.docx
